proposal: Exact size-weighted mixture of six W0(p7) anchors; independent1/K thinning; rejected proposals remain zeros
event: Frozen primary mixture-score exceedance intersect union of W7 anchors, all two variants and complete grammar retained
estimate: sum(anchor exact probabilities) * total thinned event hits / total proposal count
interval: Exact two-sided95% Clopper-Pearson for thinned event indicator, multiplied by exact sum(anchor probabilities)
weighted_secondary: mean(sum_b/K * primary_event), calculated on all proposals
G_screen: Any balance bit over all three parity types and both count variants; proved necessary for block6 primary exceedance
secondary_policies: Tail intersect any G balance only, unless a separate necessity proof is supplied
stopping: Exactly both batches; no outcome-dependent extension or early stopping
precision_planning: Pilot29 hits per1m projects2900 successes and approximately1.9% relative standard error; this is not a promised achieved precision
